overview: A 2026-ready, hire-focused roadmap. This path covers the full spectrum from foundational computer science to advanced Apple Intelligence integration, spatial computing, and professional interview readiness.

steps.title: 1. Computer Science & Swift Mastery
steps.description: The logical foundation required for any high-paying engineering role.
subtopics: Data Structures: Arrays, Linked Lists, Stacks, Queues, Hash Maps, and Tries
Algorithms: Sorting, Binary Search, BFS/DFS, and Kadane’s Algorithm
Time/Space Complexity: Mastering Big O for performance optimization
Advanced Swift: Protocols, Generics, Enums with Associated Values, and Swift Macros
Memory Management: ARC (Automatic Reference Counting), retain cycles, and weak/unowned references
Structured Concurrency: Async/await, Actors, Task Groups, and GCD

steps.title: 2. Modern UI & UX Excellence
steps.description: Mastering Apple's design philosophy to build 'premium' feeling apps.
subtopics: SwiftUI Mastery: State management (@State, @Binding, @Observable macro) and Layouts
Apple Human Interface Guidelines (HIG): Spacing, typography, and motion standards
Accessibility (A11y): Dynamic Type, VoiceOver, and high-contrast support
Advanced Animations: Phase-based animations and custom transitions for polish
UIKit Interoperability: Managing legacy codebases using UIViewControllerRepresentable

steps.title: 3. Data & Scalable Architecture
steps.description: Building modular apps that handle millions of users without breaking.
subtopics: SwiftData: Macro-based local persistence (modern successor to Core Data)
Architecture Patterns: MVVM (Standard), VIPER (Complex), and Clean Architecture
Networking: URLSession with async/await, Codable, and Alamofire
Dependency Management: Swift Package Manager (SPM) and CocoaPods
CloudKit: Seamless data syncing across the Apple ecosystem

steps.title: 4. Apple Intelligence & On-Device AI
steps.description: Integrating Apple's 2026 AI foundation directly into your apps.
subtopics: Foundation Models Framework: On-device text summarization and extraction
App Intents: Exposing app features to Siri and Apple Intelligence
Core ML & Create ML: Running and training custom vision/NLP models on-device
Writing Tools & Image Playground: Integrating system-wide AI capabilities
Privacy-First AI: Local processing and Private Cloud Compute principles

steps.title: 5. Specialist Domains (Pick 1-2)
steps.description: Niche skills that differentiate senior candidates in the job market.
subtopics: Spatial Computing (VisionOS): 3D interfaces and immersive volumes
WatchOS & HealthKit: Complications and fitness data integration
Performance Optimization: Using Instruments to profile CPU, memory, and battery
CI/CD & DevOps: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, and Fastlane automation
Security: Keychain storage, Biometrics, and HTTPS/TLS best practices

steps.title: 6. Career Readiness & Hiring Prep
steps.description: The 'everything else' required to actually land the offer.
subtopics: Interview Mastery: Behavioral STAR stories and System Design for iOS
Portfolio: Host apps on the App Store with clear READMEs and demo videos
Soft Skills: Communication, critical thinking, and team player attitude
App Store Connect: Handling certificates, provisioning profiles, and App Store rules
